summary: Build a funder-aligned pipeline, draft stronger requests, and track donor commitments. Explore this practical five-day training course.
lede: Fund mobilization training helps fundraising, grants, and resource mobilization staff match funding needs with suitable opportunities. Participants practise funding-gap analysis, prospect qualification, funder-aligned proposal and budget development using Theory of Change, and tracking commitments and reporting dates, with donor stewardship focused on accurate, responsible communication.
audienceIntro: This foundation course suits staff who contribute directly to funding research, grant applications, donor communications, and the tracking of contributions and reporting obligations.
prerequisites: Basic familiarity with your organization’s programme activities and budgets will help you contribute to the exercises. No coding or programming is required.
